description: The M0 refund fixture: partial refunds and a 60-day window across migration, service, API, client and UI, with an Unrequested audit change, a moved helper, a formatting-only file and a lockfile bump.

intent.goal: Let support staff refund part of an order, and extend the refund window to 60 days.
requirements: Support staff can refund part of an order, up to what remains to be refunded
Refunds are allowed up to 60 days after purchase

pullRequest.title: Partial refunds and a 60-day window
pullRequest.body: Support can now refund part of an order, up to the remaining balance. The refund window goes from 30 to 60 days.

domainChanges: Refunds can be partial, up to the remaining balance
Refunds are allowed up to 60 days after purchase, was 30
Refund audit entries no longer record the operator
Shipping is refunded only with the final refund
